goal: packaged application drives the real solver end to end
how: the exe re-execs the venv interpreter (ANTOPT_REEXEC=1, PYTHONPATH=_MEIPASS), because a frozen build cannot import PyAEDT and its sys.executable cannot start the guard worker

cross_check.note: the packaged application reproduces the source-path measurement of the same design to about 1e-6 dBi

defects_found_on_the_way: a bundled JSON data file was missing (caught by --selftest)
a missing dataset aborted GUI start-up with a 503 (now recorded as dataset_error)
the guard worker was spawned with sys.executable = the application (fixed: AUDIT_MCP_PYTHON)
InProcessBridge cannot work inside a frozen build, and StdioBridge is async-only
the acceptance script hung because terminating the launcher left the child holding the pipe
